notes: every_site_core.py: for each of the five BB1 parameters.comparisons (F1 Lambda_N vs Lambda_{N+1}; F2 Lambda_N vs Lambda_{N+1}; F1 vs F2 fixed N; two centered boxes Lambda_M, Lambda_M' with M,M'>=N; two one-prescription volumes containing Lambda_N, using two genuinely non-cubic cuboids), at N=2,3,4, and for EVERY site u of Lambda_N (not only u in R={0,e_z}, which is all the BA1 gate itself admits), every independently-built source term lies at coarse l-infinity distance at least N-|u|_inf from u: min_slack>=0 in every (comparison,N) case checked, with min_slack=0 (the bound attained) for comparisons 1-3 and for the F1 branch of comparison 4, confirming Lemma B5 / Theorem B6 of the BB1 reverse report and Item 4a/Section 8 of the BB1 forward report independently, from scratch, at the level of individual whole stars (F1) and individual omitted faces (F2). As an independent correctness check on the reconstruction itself, the exact source-term counts match the closed forms named in the BB1 reverse report bit-for-bit: 8(3N^2+3N+1) new F1 stars (152/296/488 at N=2,3,4), 56(9N^2+14N+6) new F2 faces (3920/7224/11536) and 28N(5N+1) F1-vs-F2 extra faces (616/1344/2352). No failure was found at any lattice site of Lambda_N (2^3=125, 7^3=343 or 9^3=729 sites, N=2,3,4 respectively) across any of the fifteen (comparison,N) instances checked.

translation_faces.py: enumerating all 64 fine translations of the period window [0,8)x[0,4)x[0,2) named in the BB2 reverse report (Lemma 7.2), exactly 8 map the anchored face/owner/role structure onto itself class by class, and these 8 are exactly the coarse translations (4v_x,2v_y,v_z) for v in {0,1}^3 -- reproducing the reverse report's own witness (t=(1,0,0) maps the selected xy face at r=2,s=0 onto the class r=3,s=0, which is omitted with owner set {0,e_x}) independently, from the I1 face table alone, not from the report's prose. Separately, this script builds the per-anchor owner-type HISTOGRAM check the task asked for and confirms it is a genuine pitfall: because the fixed multiplicity histogram (3,1,1,10,2,4) over the six omitted owner-set types is literally the SAME dict at every anchor of the lattice (independent of position, hence of any translation), a check that only compares this histogram at anchor b against the histogram at the naively shifted anchor b+(tx//4,ty//2,tz) 'accepts' all 56 non-coarse translations in the window exactly as readily as the 8 true symmetries -- it carries no information at all about face identity.

item5_range.py: cross-validated its independent re-implementation of the BB2 item-5 bracket against every per-N value each producer's own results.json tabulates (reverse F1/F2 at N=5,6,10,20; forward at N=5,10): relative agreement of order 1e-9 to 3e-12 in every case (the tiny residual is expected, since this script's directed e^y enclosure is computed by an independent method from each producer's own). Two findings follow. (1) K5 on 5<=N<=14000: this script's own certified K5 (about 5.1e-9 to 5.5e-9, attained at N=5 for all three constant sets: the forward producer's combined C_dyn, and the reverse producer's C_dyn[F1] and C_dyn[F2] separately) is a valid but substantially TIGHTER bound than the reverse producer's own reported item5_K5_certified_5_to_14000 (about 1.37e-8 to 1.42e-8, roughly 2.6x looser) -- not a contradiction (both are valid upper bounds, and the reverse producer's own per-N values match this script's exactly, so the gap is in how the whole-range certificate was assembled, not in any per-N value), but worth recording since it shows real margin remains in the reverse producer's own reported constant. (2) Exceeds 2 at N=14419/14420/14421: for all three constant sets, the bracket certifiably EXCEEDS 2 (the trivial universal bound) at all three of N=14419, 14420 and 14421 -- not only at N=14421, the single witness named in the reverse report's 'vacuous from N=14421 on' remark. A finer scan (N=14400..14425, reverse F1 constants) finds the bracket first exceeds 2 at N=14419 and stays above 2 through 14425 with no recovery in that window. This REFINES but does not CONTRADICT the reverse report, which never claims validity for N in (14000,14421) and only names N=14421 as a witness of vacuity, not as the first one.
